vision.name: Saiyan Pose
vision.text:
(Limit 2 per deck. You cannot win by MPPV if you play this card.)
POWER: Your opponent's next attack this combat deals -3 stages and -3 life cards of damage. Whenever you Rejuvenate a Styled card this combat, gain 2 stages.
[Trait:Fusion]: Whenever one of your effects destroys or banishes cards from your Life Deck this combat, raise your anger 1 level.
(Banish after use.)
vision.note: no Endurance badge; icon zoomed; F badge confirmed as Fusion by the T_Fusion trait card
